seller_name.description: Name of the shop, supplier or business that issued the bill

seller_gstin.description: 15-character GSTIN of the seller, if printed

seller_licence.description: Seller drug licence number, printed as D.L. No or DL No on pharmacy bills. Join multiple numbers with a comma

buyer_name.description: Name of the customer or party the bill is issued to

buyer_gstin.description: 15-character GSTIN of the buyer or party the bill is issued to, if printed

buyer_licence.description: Buyer drug licence number, if printed

bill_date.description: Date on the bill, as written

due_date.description: Due date or payment date, if any

salesman.description: Salesman, agent or representative name printed on the bill

order_number.description: Purchase order or order reference number, if printed

subtotal.description: Taxable value: the amount before tax, in rupees

discount_amount.description: Total discount in rupees, if shown as a separate line

cgst_amount.description: CGST amount in rupees. Only the CGST half, not the total tax

sgst_amount.description: SGST or UTGST amount in rupees. Only the SGST half, not the total tax

igst_amount.description: IGST amount in rupees, on an interstate bill

cess_amount.description: Cess amount in rupees, if any

tax_amount.description: Total GST on the bill in rupees, all components added together

round_off.description: Rounding adjustment in rupees. Negative if it was subtracted

amount_in_words.description: The total written out in words, if printed

terms.description: Payment terms or credit days, if printed

is_handwritten.description: True if the key values are handwritten rather than printed

items.description: Line items on the bill, one entry per row of the table

pack.description: Pack or packing size, such as 10x10, 1x30ML, STRIP

hsn.description: HSN or SAC code for this line

expiry.description: Expiry date for this line, as written, often MM/YY

free_qty.description: Free or scheme quantity, if a separate column

mrp.description: Printed maximum retail price per unit in rupees

rate.description: Rate charged per unit in rupees, before tax

gst_pct.description: Total GST percentage on this line, for example 12 or 18
